en: Colorized street scene showing an early 20th‑century town. A broad unpaved road is lined with trees and multi‑story houses. On the right is a red building with a sign for an apothecary, and several pedestrians, including a man walking with a small child, are visible. An early motorcar drives along the street. At the top, printed text identifies the view as 'Neumark i. S. Werdauerstrasse.'
